:::{#exm-Coxme}
## Mixed Effects Cox model
Continuing with the example of the Cox proportional hazards model from @exm-Cox, we can extend the model to include random effects (see @sex-Random_Effects).

:::{.panel-tabset}
## R
```{r}
#| eval: false
#| echo: true
#| warning: false
# Packages
library(survival)
library(tidyverse)
library(coxme)

# Data
data_f <- survival::lung |>
    dplyr::select(-c(ph.ecog, ph.karno, pat.karno, meal.cal, wt.loss)) |>
    dplyr::mutate(sex = dplyr::if_else(sex == 1, "Male", "Female")) |>
    dplyr::mutate_at(.vars = c("inst", "status", "sex"), .funs = as.factor)

# Model
# * status == 2: event, status == 1: censored
coxme_fit <- coxme::coxme(survival::Surv(time, status == 2) ~ age + sex + (1 | inst), data_f)

## Coefficients
summary(coxme_fit)
```
:::
